lines.en: Sssss, you moved.
Coming for you, don't move.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步声，一步不差。
lines.en: I count your footsteps, every one of them.

lines.zh: 腐烂的甜味，会先到你鼻子。
lines.en: A sweet rot will reach your nose first.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都低了头。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass bows its head.
You can't run, stop.
You can't avoid my sight.
Don't dream, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 你的声音引来了我的注意。
lines.en: Your sound caught my attention.

lines.zh: 一百二十八格，你跑不完。
lines.en: A hundred twenty-eight blocks. You won't outrun it.

lines.zh: 我踏过的地方草都枯了。
lines.en: Grass withers where I tread.
A hundred blocks of tracking; you get no rest.
Silence is best.
I count the breathing inside the house.

lines.zh: 三天了，我一直在你附近。
lines.en: Three days now, and I stay near you.
Wait, wait, wait.
I crouch on the eaves, waiting for you to sleep.

lines.zh: 你一出声，我就知道你醒了。
lines.en: The moment you make a sound, I know you're awake.
Don't move, don't move.
Come out quickly.
I can smell you.

lines.zh: 我隔着一百多格，已经跟着你。
lines.en: From over a hundred blocks, I am already following.
I only come after the fourth night.
You raise my intensity yourself.
The deeper the night, the more awake I am.
In the silence I count your heartbeats.
You're here.
Did you move?
I'm watching you.

lines.zh: 我在窗外，玻璃上只有你的脸。
lines.en: I'm outside the window; the glass shows only your face.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗里，一直在你身上。
lines.en: My eyes in the dark never leave you.
You're here, don't move.

lines.zh: 一百格的追踪，跑不掉的。
lines.en: A hundred-block tracking. You can't shake it.
The moment you rise, I'm at the door.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在窗外，一直没眨。
lines.en: My eyes are at the window, never blinking.
I'm tracking you.

lines.zh: 一百二十八格内，你回头也没用。
lines.en: Within a hundred blocks, looking back won't help.
Your shadow has one more in it.
I am in the dark beyond your window.
Lighting a torch will not help you.
I watched you lock the door.
Have you counted the steps behind you?
Look up. I am above you.
When you turn, I am still right there.
These eyes never blink.
You hold your breath; I am listening too.
Decaying flesh.
I'm hurt.
Wound hurts.
I'm dying.
Attack fails.
Need to rest.
Not long now.
You're weakening me.
You hurt me.

lines.zh: 一百二十八格内，我都在追你。
lines.en: Within a hundred and twenty-eight blocks, I am still after you.

lines.zh: 你散发出我渴望的气息。
lines.en: You emit the scent I crave.

lines.zh: 靠近点，让我品尝你的恐惧。
lines.en: Come closer, I want to taste your fear.
Your flesh is my meal.

lines.zh: 逃离我，只会让你更美味。
lines.en: Run from me, it only makes you tastier.

lines.zh: 享受你的恐惧，这将加速转化。
lines.en: Enjoy your fear, it speeds the transformation.
You are my new prey.

lines.zh: 你的生命之气吸引着我。
lines.en: Your life essence draws me.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我吸了进去。
lines.en: I breathed in the white mist of your breath.

lines.zh: 我的耐心正一点点消失。
lines.en: My patience is waning.

lines.zh: 你的挣扎只会延长痛苦。
lines.en: Your struggle only prolongs the pain.
Collide with me, and you lose more.
Try to harm me, you'll suffer the consequences.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你自己撞上来。
lines.en: I stand still; you're the one who walked into me.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你想象的更坚硬。
lines.en: My body is harder than you imagine.
Your strength is useless against me.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过我，凉得刺骨。
lines.en: Your hand passes through me, cold to the bone.
My presence makes you weak.

lines.zh: 一百点血，追你一百二十八格。
lines.en: A hundred health, chasing for a hundred and twenty-eight blocks.
You're close, closer to destruction.

lines.zh: 我的防御超乎你的想象。
lines.en: My defenses are beyond your imagination.
Come to me, we evolve together.
My kind are stronger.
My genes elevate you.
Join with me, feel the power.
We enhance each other.
My presence will change you.
With me, you will be perfect.
Our union is inevitable.
My strength will flow into you.
Mate with me, feel the transformation.
The Denatured is here!
Scanning you...
The taint grows stronger...

lines.zh: 一百点血，追你一百多格。
lines.en: A hundred health, and a hundred blocks of chase.
The corruption spreads...
Prey in the shadows...
Close to danger...
The whispers of corruption...

lines.zh: 你掉下的火把，我替你捡着。
lines.en: The torch you dropped, I'm holding for you.
The unseen threat...

lines.zh: 一百点血，一百多格内我都追。
lines.en: A hundred health, and I chase across a hundred blocks.

lines.zh: 你的汗味从门缝里出来。
lines.en: The smell of your sweat comes through the door crack.

lines.zh: 变异的我，已经追上你了。
lines.en: Denatured, I've already caught up.

lines.zh: 八格之外，我已闻到腐味。
lines.en: Eight blocks off, I smell the rot.
Lock acquired!
Perceived you!
Target clear!
Tracking initiated!

lines.zh: 一百二十八格内，我都能闻到你。
lines.en: Within a hundred and twenty-eight blocks, I smell you.
Lock complete!
One hundred twenty-eight blocks. Run.
The event has chosen you.
I finally caught your scent.
You are my only target now.
From behind, I have you locked.
The hunt begins. Don't stop.
Eye lock!

lines.zh: 玻璃里那个影子，我锁住了。
lines.en: I've locked onto the shadow in the glass.
On you!

lines.zh: 你的轮廓在雾里，很清楚。
lines.en: Your outline in the mist is very clear.
Aim locked!
Gaze fixed!
Line of sight!
Vision locked!
I count every step you take.
You just turned into a dead end.
Your breathing gives you away.
I am in no hurry. I have all night.
I can see you through the wall.

lines.zh: 你每往门边挪一步，我跟一步。
lines.en: Every step you take toward the door, I take one.
Don't run. It only speeds things up.

lines.zh: 你踩到的那块地板，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the floorboard you stepped on.
Your torchlight is shaking.

lines.zh: 我一百二十八格的追踪没有断过。
lines.en: My hundred-twenty-eight block pursuit never broke.
You have nowhere left to retreat.
I am pressed into your shadow.

lines.zh: 一百二十八格，我跟着你。
lines.en: A hundred and twenty-eight blocks of following you.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙缝里全是冷气。
lines.en: I bite down, my teeth full of cold air.

lines.zh: 一百二十八格内，都算我的。
lines.en: Everything within a hundred and twenty-eight blocks is mine.
No escape, come to die!
Feel the fear!

lines.zh: 我的手比你的胳膊还长。
lines.en: My hand is longer than your arm.
Sss, rip your flesh!

lines.zh: 我的指甲在你脖子上停了一拍。
lines.en: My nails pause one beat on your neck.
Here, my prey!
My claws reach out before I ask.
I have your wrist.
I don't need eyes for this one.
You hear the sound of bone.
Don't struggle. It ends sooner.
My fingers are far too long.
The pain is only the beginning.
A glimpse from the shadows!
Eyes in the darkness!
Silent approach!
Terror's whisper!

lines.zh: 一百点血的恐变体，跟着你了。
lines.en: A hundred-point denatured, and it follows you.

lines.zh: 第四夜的门外，多了一双脚印。
lines.en: Outside your door on the fourth night, there is an extra set of footprints.
Whispers in the shadows!
Threat in the shadows!
I step out of the event itself.

lines.zh: 事件把我放到你脚边了。
lines.en: The event dropped me at your feet.
On the fourth night, I arrive.
A breath has appeared behind you.
The light outside does not reach me.
The event has begun.
I grow at the edge of your sight.
The floor beside your bed creaked.
You never heard the door open.

lines.zh: 我进你的屋子时，没碰门。
lines.en: When I entered your house, I never touched the door.
The air turned cold first.
Don't light the lamp. I've come for you.
Burned by fire!
Fell and hurt!

lines.zh: 身体开始溃烂.，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Decaying flesh — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了追击的脚步。
lines.en: The blast knocked my pursuit off its feet.
Arrow hit me!
Magic hit me!

lines.zh: 我被你伤到了.，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm hurt — and the starvation makes it worse.
Lightning hit me!
Void hit me!
